main_body: Wooden dresser: a top surface carrying a bottle, a book and a red box, over a front face with four inset drawers and a dark plinth
top_band: Rows 7-11 at x=8/23 (L=130, mid orange-brown) form the top surface with props standing on it. Row 12 (L=157) is the lighter front-edge line. Row 13 is a transition, then row 14 (L=60) is a dark eave shadow.
evidence: The column at x=8 reads a 5-row top band (rows 7-11) with props standing on it, then a distinct light front-edge line at row 12, then a dark shadow row at 14, then the front face from row 15 to 30. The top is only about 21 L from the face tone, but the edge line and shadow row separate them, so it is not just a thin rim. The drawers are inset, with dark inner edges on the right and bottom and dark cross-rails. No receding side face is drawn. It matches the green cabinet in the guide (top about 5 rows, edge line, eave).

style.evidence: The wood has about 5 tones (highlight, top, face, dark recess, deep), and the drawer pulls and props add detail. Flat-fill coverage is only 3%, and there are 14 colours per tile against 17-20 in the references. The silhouette edge (left side and bottom row) is pure black, and 100% of the dark edge pixels are neutral, against 1% and 33% for the references. That is the uniform black 'sticker' outline rather than a dark tone of the adjacent wood. The wood grain is also sparse compared with the cheese stall and the well. The outline is the deciding weakness.
